title: Ba-Chaane Deen Ko Sarwar Gala Katatey Hai
body:
Ba-chaane deen ko Sarwar gala katatey hai
Kiya jo rab se tha wada use nibhaatey hai
1. Jo pocha bano ne ashger kahan hai aye wali
Hussain bano ko laashe pisar dekhatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hussain fatha ka elaan karne ko ashger
Gala pa teer e sitam khaake muskuraatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tumara marne se tooti kamar meri bhaiya
Hussain gazi ke laashe pe kehte jaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Na koi moniso Yawar na hai alam bar dar
Jawan ki laash ko maidan se shah utha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ye rooke kehti thi Zainab ke aao aye Abbas
Aado tamache Sakina ko ab lagatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sakina kehti thi aakar chacha zara dekho
Dekha ke paani zameen par ado bahatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dua e deti hai un ko Hussain ki madar
Ghar o mein apne jo farsh e aza bechatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hai jiske dil me ziyarat ki Aarzoo sahil
Zaror usku shah e Karbala bulatey hai
Azz...alamdaar sahil
